overall_assessment: MULTI-CRISIS ACTIVE: Iran-Hormuz war (CAT 5), Yen-JGB sovereign crisis (CAT 5), Ebola PHEIC (CAT 5), China property (CAT 4), UK food security (CAT 4), ECB final hike (CAT 3). Gold at 4429 (+33.5pct YoY). Risk board CRITICAL.

category_5_events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis - Iran-US War Active
category_5_events.summary: Iran-US war ongoing. IRGC closed Hormuz July 12. Tanker explosions Aug 5. Trump claims US control, Iran refutes. 20pct global oil/LNG disrupted. Brent ~87-91/bbl.

category_5_events.title: US-Japan Yen Intervention Unraveling - JGB Yields Decades-High
category_5_events.summary: Joint US-Japan FX intervention July 31 unraveling. Yen back to ~159. US sold euros not dollars - ECB blindsided. JGB 10Y 2.93pct 30yr high. JGB 2Y 1.65pct since 1995. BOJ pressured Sept/Oct hike.

category_5_events.title: Ebola Epidemic - Fastest-Growing on Record (PHEIC)
category_5_events.summary: DRC Ebola largest in history. 4945 cases, 2325 deaths, 730 hospitalized. Bundibugyo species - no vaccine. WHO PHEIC May 17. Spread to Uganda.

category_4_events.title: China Property Crisis - 148B Lease Time Bomb + AMC Distress
category_4_events.summary: 148B expiring leases. 130B developer defaults. Office values down 40pct+. AMCs themselves distressed. PBOC loose but deflation persists.

category_4_events.title: UK Food Security Crisis - Worst in Decades
category_4_events.summary: UK worst food security crisis in decades. 75pct England in drought. Wildfire emergency alerts. Milk production hit.

category_3_events.title: ECB Final Rate Hike Expected Sept
category_3_events.summary: Reuters poll: ECB hike next month. Energy prices pushing inflation from 2pct target. Bund 3.20pct near 15yr highs.
